dedupe_keys.name: japan regional residential and industrial electricity demand and prices 1990 2015

description: This dataset assembles annual regional electricity consumption, consumption intensity and electricity prices for Japan during 1990–2015. The producer compiled residential and industrial sector data from energy statistics, the Economic Census, resident registers and price indices, with electricity-company reports identified in the article. Mendeley provides a single Excel workbook free under CC BY 4.0. Geographic coverage is regional aggregation within Japan, and temporal resolution is annual, so the data do not represent feeder loads or hourly dispatch conditions. Differences in sector definitions and deflators require attention before interpreting regional price-demand relationships. A reviewer-assessed use is estimating long-term demand sensitivities or constructing regional electricity scenarios for capacity-planning simulations. model-pypsa is a related planning environment, but annual totals need additional temporal profiles before operational modelling. No workbook cells were inspected and no causal price elasticity was estimated. A separate first-review study of Japan’s 2011 shortage is not this input compilation.
